name: Concejo Deliberante de Coronel Pringles
detail: The 19 November 2020 proposal to endorse the national levy was sent to archive by majority vote; the proposer is recorded separately.

name: Matías David Rodríguez
detail: Voted for the levy in the Chamber of Deputies on 18 Nov 2020; Wikidata gives a date of death.

name: Alejandro Daniel Bermejo
detail: Died 17 May 2023 in Mendoza; provincial senator and former national deputy who voted for Ley 27.605 on 18 Nov 2020.

name: Carlos Saúl Menem
detail: Died 14 February 2021; former President and national senator who voted for Ley 27.605 in the Senate roll call of 4 Dec 2020.

name: Martín Lousteau
detail: Spoke against and voted against the Aporte Solidario (Ley 27.605) in the Senate on 4 December 2020.
